lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba₄Al₄Mg₄O₁₂ (reduced formula BaAlMgO₃) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁/amd (No. 15), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Al and Mg centers as tetrahedral, each coordinated by four O neighbors, while Ba centers show eight O neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement. The tetrahedral Al and Mg polyhedra share corners and edges with one another and corners with Ba polyhedra; the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites.
